title: Emacs From Scratch #1 - Getting Started with a Basic Usable Configuration
summary: The first stream in the Emacs From Scratch series, building a custom Emacs configuration from zero while teaching basics. It covers a usable baseline setup and the packages for completion, themes and productivity.
why: Recommended as a thoughtful, step-by-step way to build your own Emacs config rather than starting from Doom or Spacemacs.

quote.text: System Crafters' 'Emacs from Sratch' series [0], which is incredibly well thought-out
